response.overview: Desperate to land the role of a lifetime, a struggling actor turns to a forgotten stage legend whose brutal, unorthodox methods force him to confront the very despair his monologue was written about — and the two men discover the only way through it is together.  Starring:  Arjun Balaji Obaid Akbar Pulari Gilbert Osiel Serrato  Directed by: Arjun Balaji Written by: Obaid Akbar Produced by: Arjun Balaji and Obaid Akbar Cinematography by: Osiel Serrato Sound Engineer: Bradford Storm and Ryan Hendrix Lighting Engineer/ Camera Operator: Karan Jatoth Location Manager: Justin Ciru Lara Social Media Manager: Pulari Gilbert Edited By: Arjun Balaji  An Ordinary Ego Production
response.title: COPY OF HAMLET
